title: Anode interphase design for fast-charging lithium-based rechargeable batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE06107A, Review Article
Xiancheng Wang, Zihe Chen, Shiyu Liu, Shuibin Tu, Renming Zhan, Li Wang, Yongming Sun
This review underscores the critical significance of outer and inner interphase designs of anode materials in pursuit of high-energy-density lithium-based rechargeable batteries with fast-charging capability.
